summary: Changes since sdk==0.4.6 release(sdk-py): 0.4.7 ( #9289 ) release(langgraph): 1.2.15 ( #9283 ) fix(sdk-py): end a thread stream's run only on a root lifecycle event ( #9228 ) fix: order delta channel replay by task path ( #8544 ) release(langgraph): 1.2.14 ( #9215 )
body:
Changes since sdk==0.4.6

- release(sdk-py): 0.4.7 ( #9289 )

- release(langgraph): 1.2.15 ( #9283 )

- fix(sdk-py): end a thread stream's run only on a root lifecycle event ( #9228 )

- fix: order delta channel replay by task path ( #8544 )

- release(langgraph): 1.2.14 ( #9215 )
summaryZh: LangGraph发布了Python SDK 0.4.7版本。更新明确了仅在根生命周期事件触发时才终止线程流运行，避免子任务提前退出导致的流式异常，并同步合并了任务回放排序修复。该版本有助于提升Agent服务端与客户端通信调用的鲁棒性。

aiReview.reasonZh: LangGraph客户端SDK例行更新，规范了线程流生命周期的结束判定机制。
